explanation: Shift all 64 bits into a new unsigned result in reverse order, including leading zeros. This compact implementation computes the transformation directly without precomputed expected outputs.
timeComplexity: O(64), constant time for a 64-bit word.
attribution: Original C++ implementation and explanation authored for EPI Practice from the displayed 64-bit reversal contract and the repository-authored C# algorithm. Uses the existing local test-framework API; no upstream reference implementation was altered.
